description: Change 1 to 20 settings of a Cloudflare zone, in order, where a change lowers a visitor's protection: a lower step of ssl, min_tls_version or security_level, or turning off always_use_https, automatic_https_rewrites, tls_1_3 or email_obfuscation. Always confirmed. Every setting is read first, and nothing is sent if a value is not accepted, a setting is already at the value, or the zone's plan does not let you change it. If a later change fails, the result lists what was changed, the failure and the settings not sent. Zones are looked up only in the account's own zones.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

changes.description: 1 to 20 changes, each setting at most once, applied in order. Allowed values: ssl: off|flexible|full|strict; always_use_https: on|off; min_tls_version: 1.0|1.1|1.2|1.3; tls_1_3: on|off|zrt; automatic_https_rewrites: on|off; http3: on|off; ipv6: on|off; websockets: on|off; development_mode: on|off; security_level: off|essentially_off|low|medium|high|under_attack; cache_level: basic|simplified|aggressive; browser_cache_ttl: 0|30|60|120|300|1200|1800|3600|7200|10800|14400|18000|28800|43200|57600|72000|86400|172800|259200|345600|432000|691200|1382400|2073600|2678400|5356800|16070400|31536000; always_online: on|off; email_obfuscation: on|off.

value.description: The new value; browser_cache_ttl takes seconds (0 respects the origin's headers).

name: cloudflare_zone_setting_weaken

changed.description: The changes that were applied, in order.

after.description: The value Cloudflare reports after the change, or null.

modified_on.description: When the setting was last modified, or null.

time_remaining.description: Time remaining for temporary settings, or null.

failed.description: The change that failed after earlier ones were applied; the rest were not sent.

not_sent.description: The settings after the failed one, which were not sent.

zone.description: The zone the settings belong to.

title: Lower Cloudflare zone protection
